jobs.description:
Do you know what needs to be in place before a new power or gas market can go-live?

Can you combine commercial understanding with regulation, market design and project execution? As Senior Market Expansion Manager, you will coordinate new market entries and trading products from development through go-live, while helping improve the way these expand into new markets in NET.

The team

The Market Expansion team is responsible for expanding the footprint of Norlys Energy Trading (NET). The team works with colleagues across the company on new markets and trading products, coordinating the activities needed to prepare, implement, and launch them. The work changes from project to project, depending on the market, product, and stakeholders involved.

The role

You will lead projects related to new markets and trading products and coordinate the work needed to get them ready for go-live . This includes managing progress, aligning stakeholders, and handling the commercial, regulatory, and operational complexity that comes with entering new markets.

You will also be responsible for the lifecycle management of active markets and trading products and contribute to improving the Market Expansion  method.

Key responsibilities

Your work will cover both implementing new markets and trading products and expanding existing markets and trading products.

• Manage market and trading product development, implementation and go-live.

• Coordinate activities ahead of new market entries.

• Oversee the lifecycle of active markets and trading products.

• Align stakeholders during implementation and go-live.

• Work with market design, regulation, and business complexity.

• Develop and improve the Market Expansion team’s methods.

I’m looking for someone who is comfortable working in a setting where not everything is predefined. You need to be able to understand the commercial context, ask the right questions and bring the right people together when a new market or product is moving towards go-live.

Lea Vestergaard Klattrup

Manager, Market Expansion

What we are looking for

You have experience from a similar role and understand the practical and commercial considerations involved in entering power and gas markets. You are comfortable working with complexity and with colleagues from different parts of the business.

Must-haves:

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience from a similar position.

• Commercial flair and a good understanding of how trading markets operate.

• Understanding the different aspects involved in entering and implementing new markets.

• Ability to work with market design, regulation, and business complexity.

• Strong project management skills incl. a strong ability to navigate stakeholders on all levels of the organization.

What we offer

You will join a team working directly with NET’s market footprint and have a broad interface with the rest of the company.

• Responsibility for projects that span development, implementation and go-live.

• Collaboration with colleagues across different areas of NET.

• Work across both power and gas markets.

• A mix of new market entries, trading products and lifecycle management.

• The opportunity to help shape the Market Expansion team’s working methods.

Interested?

If the role matches your experience and you are curious about working with market expansion at NET, we would like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Lea Vestergaard Klattrup

Manager, Market Expansion

lvk@norlysenergytrading.com

What makes a product worth bringing to market?

Can you spot the right commercial opportunities, set a clear direction and get the right people moving? In this role, you will work close to both market needs and internal decision-making, with room to influence how product management develops at NET.

The team

You will join the Product Management team in Client Solutions at Norlys Energy Trading (NET) in Aalborg. The team develops and maintains competitive and profitable products that connect clients to energy markets.

The work is closely linked to market-facing teams across the organisation, with a strong focus on relevance, profitability, and speed.

The role

As Senior Product Manager, you will be responsible for selected products and product lines from early scoping through development, launch, performance follow-up and eventual offboarding.

You will define direction, coordinate stakeholders, and keep commercial priorities on track. At the same time, you will contribute to the continued development of NET’s Product Management Method and help strengthen the product management capability across Client Solutions.

Key responsibilities

The role combines commercial judgement, product ownership and coordination across the organisation.

• Define product and product line strategies based on client segment needs and market opportunities.

• Scope and develop new products in line with the internal Product Development and Implementation process.

• Lead launches, implementation, improvements, and offboarding.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders and maintain progress across initiatives.

• Align go-to-market activities with relevant market-facing teams.

• Monitor financial and operational performance and follow up on results.

• Improve the Product Management Method with a focus on agility, profitability and short time to market.

• Participate in selected market events and fairs, with some travel to be expected.

If you like being close to the commercial side of the market, having real ownership and working across all levels of the organisation, this is the role for you. You will also join at a point where there is room to influence how product management is shaped going forward.

Jakob Bro Nielsen

Head of Commercial Solutions

What we are looking for

You are commercially strong, comfortable taking responsibility and used to working across stakeholders to move initiatives forward.

Must-haves

• Proven commercial success from previous roles.

• Experience from energy trading or a closely related industry.

• Experience bringing commercial ideas to the market.

• Strong project management skills and well versed in management of internal stakeholders on all levels of the organisation.

• Relevant educational background, preferably Master’s degree

Additional qualification

• Ability to contribute to the continued development of NET’s product management capability.

What we offer

• Broad responsibility across product direction, development and performance.

• Influence on how product management develops within Client Solutions.

• Close interaction with market-facing teams across the organisation.

• Participation in market events and fairs.

Interested?

If the role sounds relevant to your background, we would like to hear from you. We meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Jakob Bro Nielsen

Head of Commercial Solutions

jbn@norlysenergytrading.com

_Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

__We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

_As Portfolio Architect you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

You will report into senior technology leadership and work in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to set technical direction, govern architectural standards, and accelerate the adoption of LLMs, agentic systems, and ML pipelines across the portfolio.

**What You'll Do

****Architecture Leadership

**

• Define and evolve the portfolio-level technical architecture across Basware’s product suite, ensuring coherence, scalability, and strategic alignment

• Set architectural review processes for AI and set engineering standards that span teams and products

• Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and opportunities for platform consolidation.

**AI/ML Platform Strategy

**

• Lead architectural decisions across LLMs, agentic workflows, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and ML inference infrastructure

• Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation

• Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

**MLOps & Governance

**

• Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation

• Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

• Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

**Strategic Partnership

**

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact

• Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions

• Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

**Essential

****What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company

• Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc

• Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)

• Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers

• Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

**Highly Desirable

**

• Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale

• Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design

• Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines

• Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)

• Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

**Location & Ways of Working

**This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

**What We Offer

**

• A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction

• Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus

• Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture

• Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

**Why Basware?

**We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

**Ready to make an impact?

**If you're excited by the challenge, **apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

**Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the ‘I’m interested’ link.

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check.

**Basware. Now it all just happens.

**

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Shaping BIM, 3D and visualization at Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux, Innovating the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and we’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape the future of BIM and make complex building information accessible and useful to everyone in construction.

As a Product Manager at Dalux, you’ll operate at the intersection of customer needs, technology, and business strategy. You’ll take ownership of the product roadmap and collaborate closely with Product Design and Development teams to deliver intuitive, high-performing BIM experiences.

You’ll play a key role in evolving how our users view, navigate, understand, and collaborate around building models. Combining an understanding of BIM, UI/UX, and computer graphics, you’ll help turn complex technical capabilities into tools that work effortlessly for our users.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Product Discovery: Evaluate and prioritize new product opportunities, balancing user value, technical feasibility, and business impact.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users to understand their BIM workflows, uncover pain points, and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

• User Experience: Collaborate with Product Design to make complex BIM interactions intuitive, from navigating 3D models to finding and understanding building information.

• BIM and Visualization: Work with engineers on model visualization and interaction, balancing visual quality, responsiveness, and performance when handling large and complex building models.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Align with engineers, designers, and fellow product managers to deliver cohesive experiences across Dalux products.

• Feature Ownership: Lead new features from discovery and definition through development, delivery, and validation with users.

• Product Strategy: Help define the direction of BIM at Dalux, identifying opportunities and deciding where we should invest to deliver the greatest value.

**What To Expect As a Daluxian

**At Dalux, we offer a creative, collaborative, and supportive environment where your ideas make an impact. Here’s what you can look forward to as part of our team:

• A central location in Copenhagen, a focus on work/life balance, and no dress code.

• An active social environment with monthly events and social clubs.

• A flat organization with open communication, a short path from idea to product, and the creative freedom and trust to create tangible value for our users.

• A highly specialized, international team with room for creativity and professional growth.

• A strong focus on diversity and inclusion, where your ideas are heard and opportunities are available to all.

• Attractive employee benefits, including health insurance, a lunch plan, coffee and fruit, free fitness facilities, and free parking.

• Support for your professional development and personal well-being.

**About You

**We believe you have a solid background in product management and experience working closely with software development teams, preferably on SaaS platforms. You’re curious about how technology works and motivated by making sophisticated tools easy to use.

We also believe you:

• Have 5+ years of experience in product management, taking products or features from discovery to delivery.

• Have a background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Understand BIM workflows and how building models and their data are used across design, construction, and operations.

• Have a strong understanding of UI/UX principles and can work with designers to evaluate interaction flows, challenge unnecessary complexity, and validate solutions with users.

• Have a working understanding of computer graphics concepts such as 3D geometry, rendering, and model interaction, enabling you to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers.

• Can balance strategic thinking with attention to detail, particularly where usability, model complexity, and performance meet.

• Are comfortable working in agile development environments and prioritizing based on user insights and product outcomes.

• Communicate clearly and fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Experience with IFC, BIM viewers, or other software for working with 3D models would be an advantage.

**Ready for the next step?

**If we have managed to pique your interest, we would love to hear from you. Send us your motivated CV and an application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application today.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics. Despite being the world’s second-largest industry, construction remains one of the least digitalized, with only 30% of onsite time spent on actual building tasks. At Dalux, we’re changing this by providing end-to-end solutions that streamline the entire lifecycle of a building—from design and construction to maintenance and eventual demolition—reducing waste, time, and costs.

We stay ahead by using cutting-edge technology, including cloud solutions, drones, computer vision, and AI, to transform how the construction industry works. Over the last five years, we’ve grown by 60% annually and now have over 700 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

If you’re curious to learn more about Dalux and our products, feel free to visit our LinkedIn or website, where you can find videos and descriptions of our events, products, and the work we do.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

About FPRT

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Joining us now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

The Role

As the Senior Process Engineer, you will be crucial in ensuring the stability, safety, and continuous improvement of FPRT's production processes. This role combines engineering, optimization, and practical design to ensure every manufacturing stage—from material preparation and mixing to polymerization and final assembly - operates efficiently, safely, and in line with company standards.

You will report to the Chief Production Officer (CPO).

What You Will Do

1. Process Documentation & Standardization

• 
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all process steps, including mixing, polymerization, demolding, assembly, and testing.

• 
Observe real operations and translate them into clear, standardized, and safe work instructions.

• 
Ensure documentation aligns with HSE, ISO 9001, and defense manufacturing standards.

2. Process Optimization & Efficiency

• 
Analyze production workflows to identify manual or inefficient operations.

• 
Propose, design, or support the creation of mechanical tools, fixtures, or automated solutions that boost productivity and safety.

• 
Evaluate how existing machines and equipment are utilized; recommend modifications or redesigns for better efficiency.

• 
Apply Lean and PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) principles to reduce waste, rework, and downtime.

3. Equipment & Technical Design Support

• 
Collaborate with Maintenance and Engineering on the development and fabrication of custom in-house equipment (e.g., mixing accessories, molds, handling systems, transport carts, fixtures).

• 
Prepare basic technical sketches or 3D models for small mechanical improvements or automation concepts.

• 
Support the setup, validation, and calibration of new or modified tools and machinery.

4. Process Monitoring & Validation

• 
Monitor process parameters (temperature, pressure, vacuum, timing) and ensure compliance with defined limits.

• 
Collect and analyze process data to detect trends, variations, or potential improvements.

• 
Support validation and certification activities under CPO supervision.

What We Offer

• 
A challenging role where you act as an in-house constructor-technologist by designing custom tools, jigs, trolleys, and mechanical aids that cannot be sourced externally.

• 
An opportunity to directly impact the safety and efficiency of a unique industrial and defense-tech project in Denmark.

• 
A collaborative professional environment where you will work closely with Chemical Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, and HSE teams.

• 
Top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

What We Are Looking For

You are an individual with an analytical mindset, creativity, and hands-on problem-solving ability, driven by a safety- and quality-focused attitude.

Education:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Process, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering.

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years in process or production engineering in manufacturing, preferably defense, aerospace, or chemical.

Expertise:

• 
Strong understanding of mechanical design, ergonomics, and process optimization.

• 
Experience in documenting and validating processes and equipment.

• 
Basic CAD or 3D modeling skills (e.g., SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar).

• 
Knowledge of HSE and ISO 9001 standards.

Security Clearance & Vetting Notice

Due to the sensitive defense-tech nature of our projects and operations, all potential employees are subject to a police and intelligence background check as part of our standard recruitment process. Continued employment is conditional upon obtaining and maintaining the necessary security clearance.

Vilofoss, part of DLG Group, is looking for an experienced Global Quality Manager to lead quality, feed safety and regulatory compliance across our international Animal Nutrition business. Based in Fredericia, Denmark, you will combine a visible, hands-on role in Denmark with leadership of seven quality professionals across six European countries, 12 production sites and external manufacturing partners.

Your main assignment is to bring locally organized quality activities together in one global function. You will establish shared governance, standards, systems and reporting while ensuring that essential local activities remain close to our sites and authorities.

Your responsibilities

• Lead and develop an international team of seven quality professionals across multiple locations.

• Establish the global quality operating model and harmonize the Quality Management System, procedures, KPIs and reporting across Vilofoss.

• Drive feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement across production sites, suppliers and external manufacturing partners.

• Act as the primary contact with Danish authorities and coordinate regulatory requirements across countries, balancing common European standards with local obligations.

• Lead audits, certifications and corrective and preventive actions, including HACCP, GMP+, QS, VLOG and organic standards as examples.

• Partner with Operations, Innovation, Procurement and Supply Chain on product registrations, supplier and raw-material approval, specifications, technical documentation and market compliance.

• Align closely with DLG quality department on quality management systems and common procedures.

What you bring

• Significant senior quality experience from animal nutrition, feed, premix, feed additives, food ingredients or another regulated manufacturing environment.

• Proven international people leadership and experience aligning specialist teams through organizational change.

• Strong knowledge of feed legislation, Quality Management Systems, HACCP, audits and relevant certification schemes.

• Experience working directly with regulatory authorities and translating complex requirements into practical standards for operations.

• Sound judgement and the authority to challenge decisions, hold firm on non-negotiable requirements and act when product safety, compliance or licence to operate is at risk.

• A relevant degree in Animal Nutrition, Food Science, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering or a related field, plus fluency in Danish and English. German is an advantage.

Your opportunity

This is an international leadership role with a clear mandate to build a global quality function and shape how Vilofoss manages quality, feed safety and compliance across countries. You will work closely with operational and business leaders and have direct influence on standards, risk management and performance across the value chain related to quality.

Practical Information

The role is based in Fredericia, Denmark, and requires regular on-site collaboration with Danish operations and authorities. Expect approximately 10–15% travel within Europe.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact Christine Brøkner, Director, Animal Nutrition, at +45 25 21 77 19.

Are you someone who turns complex opportunities into measurable business results?

At PriceShape, we are looking for a Senior Account Executive to join our commercial team and take ownership of high-value opportunities across international markets. You will work with mid-market and enterprise organisations to understand their business goals and challenges and show them the value PriceShape can deliver.

This is not a product-focused role. Your success comes from driving commercial impact, shaping account strategy, and building trusted relationships with customers. You will be responsible for converting opportunities into revenue while contributing to how we sell and grow as a company.

We are looking for someone who can operate at a senior level, but we are also open to candidates who are not quite there yet. If you have a strong track record in B2B sales, the ambition to take on increasingly complex deals, and believe you have the potential to grow into the role, we encourage you to apply. We care more about your capabilities, mindset, and track record than checking every box.

What You’ll Do

You will own opportunities from start to finish and play a key role in shaping account strategy and execution.

Strategic Opportunity Ownership and Deal Execution

• 
Own and close high-value opportunities from discovery through negotiation and contract

• 
Lead structured, insight-driven discovery to understand customer priorities, risks, and growth opportunities

• 
Build business cases and value propositions tailored to each customer

• 
Develop deal strategies that align stakeholders, manage risk, and maintain momentum

• 
Lead negotiations and contract discussions with economic buyers and decision-makers

Account Development and Stakeholder Engagement

• 
Create account strategies for key opportunities and target organisations

• 
Engage multiple stakeholders across business, commercial, and technical functions

• 
Drive multi-threading to strengthen relationships and improve win probability

• 
Build trusted advisor relationships through value-led and insight-driven conversations

• 
Identify and develop expansion opportunities early in the sales process

Pipeline Leadership and Forecasting

• 
Maintain ownership of opportunities and prioritise based on strategic impact and revenue potential

• 
Keep pipeline data accurate and forecast revenue with confidence

• 
Contribute actively to pipeline reviews and strategic deal discussions with leadership

Market Insight and Commercial Impact

• 
Provide structured feedback to marketing, product, and leadership on customer needs and market trends

• 
Share insights on industry developments, competitive positioning, and emerging opportunities

• 
Help refine sales messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy

• 
Contribute to best practices in deal execution and commercial thinking

• 
Support colleagues by sharing knowledge and experience

Who You Are

You are a commercially driven sales professional who combines commercial instinct with structure and strategic thinking. You focus on understanding the customer’s business and driving value rather than leading with a product demo.

Need to have

• 
Several years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in SaaS

• 
A proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets

• 
Experience managing and progressing opportunities through a structured sales cycle

• 
Strong understanding of value-based or consultative selling

• 
Ability to run structured discovery and uncover customer business needs and drivers

• 
Confidence engaging with mid-market and/or enterprise stakeholders

• 
Strong communication and presentation skills in English

• 
A structured and disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting

• 
A proactive, resilient, and results-driven mindset

Nice to have

• 
Experience managing and closing high-value, complex deals

• 
Experience engaging senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers

• 
Experience in e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands

• 
Exposure to pricing strategy, revenue optimisation, or marketing performance tools

• 
Experience selling complex or data-driven SaaS solutions

• 
Familiarity with MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar sales methodologies

• 
Experience contributing to go-to-market strategy or scaling sales practices

• 
Additional European languages

What We Offer

• 
A role focused on high-value opportunities with real commercial impact

• 
The opportunity to work with customers and senior stakeholders across international markets

• 
A commercial environment that values quality over volume and business outcomes over features

• 
Close collaboration with BDRs and other Account Executives to drive growth together

• 
A culture built on trust, ownership, and high performance

• 
The chance to influence how we sell, position, and grow as a company

• 
Opportunities for continued development and progression into larger, more complex deals or strategic commercial roles

• 
Competitive compensation package including base salary and uncapped commission

• 
Modern office in Aarhus, with flexibility for hybrid work

About PriceShape

PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands increase revenue and profitability through dynamic pricing and competitor tracking.

We are more than 100 colleagues from 25+ nationalities and growing fast across markets. Today we serve customers in 25+ countries and aim to become the global category leader.

At PriceShape, we’re building a more data-driven, automated and scalable Marketing function — and we’re looking for someone who is excited about using AI and technology to rethink how Marketing operates.

As a MarTech Operations Specialist, you’ll own and continuously improve the technology, data and automation that power our Marketing function. You’ll connect systems, strengthen our data foundation and find new ways to use AI, automation and technology to make our Marketing engine smarter, faster and more scalable.

Working closely with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we use technology across the organisation. We’re looking for someone curious, hands-on and eager to explore what’s possible — someone who doesn’t just operate existing systems, but actively looks for better ways to build, automate and solve problems.

Job description

As a MarTech Operations Specialist, you will play an essential role in building and running the technical layer behind our Marketing function.

Your day-to-day work will span CRM, marketing automation, tracking, data, reporting, website operations, technical SEO and integrations. You’ll connect systems that would otherwise sit apart and make sure our Marketing team has reliable data, efficient workflows and the technical foundation needed to scale.

This is a build role rather than a maintenance role. You’ll be expected to identify opportunities, challenge how things are done and continuously improve the Marketing engine. You’ll use automation, AI and technology to remove manual work and build better solutions — including using code when existing platform functionality isn’t enough.

Your key responsibilities:

• 
Own HubSpot and Marketing automation, including data structure, workflows, lead capture, scoring, routing and nurture flows.

• 
Own Marketing tracking and reporting, ensuring accurate conversion tracking, analytics, dashboards and a clear connection between Marketing activity and pipeline outcomes.

• 
Own website operations and technical SEO, including WordPress, HTML/CSS, crawlability, indexation, performance, structured data and multi-market requirements such as hreflang.

• 
Build and improve integrations and automations that connect systems, remove manual work and make Marketing more efficient.

• 
Use AI, code and emerging technologies to solve problems, automate processes and build solutions beyond what existing platforms can offer.

• 
Manage and optimise the MarTech stack, evaluating new tools and continuously improving the systems we use.

• 
Ensure technical quality from the start, making new pages and campaigns trackable, indexable and performant from launch.

• 
Document systems and processes to create a scalable setup and ensure knowledge is shared across the team.

We expect you to bring the following

We’re looking for someone who is analytical, structured and technically curious, but who also enjoys building and making things happen. You’re comfortable taking ownership, solving problems independently and working across different systems and teams.

You don’t need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable with technology and data and confident enough to investigate, troubleshoot and build solutions yourself. You’re also naturally curious about new technology and actively look for ways to use AI, automation and other tools to work smarter.

Must-Have Skills

• 
4+ years experience in MarTech, Marketing Operations, RevOps, CRM or a similar technology-focused role.

• 
Hands-on experience building in HubSpot or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform: data structure, workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle management and routing you designed.

• 
Experience implementing marketing tracking, analytics, reporting and data quality.

• 
Strong understanding of automation and integrations, with the ability to connect systems and improve workflows.

• 
Experience with web technologies, ideally including WordPress and basic HTML/CSS, as well as multi-market websites and technical SEO requirements such as hreflang.

• 
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.

• 
Experience using AI and emerging technologies to build and automate solutions, including how you tested them before they touched live data.

Good-to-Have Skills

• 
Experience with APIs, webhooks, JavaScript, Python or SQL.

• 
Experience with Google Tag Manager, GA4, Looker Studio or similar tools.

• 
Experience from a B2B SaaS or scale-up environment.

What you can expect from us

• 
The opportunity to own and shape our MarTech infrastructure and have a real say in how our systems, data and automation work together.

• 
Plenty of room to build, experiment and test new technology, including AI, automation and custom solutions.

• 
A technically diverse role spanning CRM, data, tracking, integrations, web, SEO and automation — with the freedom to go beyond standard platform functionality.

• 
The opportunity to turn technical solutions into measurable business impact, supporting Marketing efficiency, lead generation and growth.

• 
Close collaboration with Marketing, Sales, RevOps and other key functions across the business.

• 
A culture built on trust, ownership and getting things done.

• 
Opportunities for continued professional and personal development.

• 
Modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

About PriceShape

PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands increase revenue and profitability through dynamic pricing and competitor tracking.

We are 100+ colleagues from 25+ nationalities and are growing across markets. Today, we serve customers in 25+ countries and aim to become the global category leader.

We value work-life balance, trust, and both personal and professional growth. We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance and great facilities across our locations in DK and Sweden.

How to apply

If you think the position is attractive and suitable, please send us a job application and your CV as soon as possible. We process and interview on an ongoing basis.

For clarifications about the position, you can contact VP Marketing - Michael Clausen at below email.

For more information or questions please contact us at msc@priceshape.dk

jobs.occupation: PhD position on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains – GreenWorlds ERC Advanced project
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School (CBS) invites applications for one PhD position on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains, located at the Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC).

The selected candidate will contribute to the ERC Advanced research project GreenWorlds: The material and normative drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains https://www.cbs.dk/en/articles/cbs-professor-receives-prestigious-erc-grant-explore-paradox-green-economy, led by Professor Stefano Ponte.

Overall Project Focus

The GreenWorlds project investigates a core tension in the global economy: how capitalism adapts to ecological pressures and normatively legitimizes itself while maintaining its core logic of capital accumulation alongside the carbon economy. To explore this, the project examines how a variety of ‘green worlds’ of value and valuation emerge, consolidate and decline. Green worlds are different sets of internally coherent principles that are drawn upon by value chain actors to deal with challenges and critiques. They are flexibly assembled by a variety of actors in different value chains and situations to enact justifications related to framing products and/or operations as ‘green’.

The research project asks: What counts as green and for whom? What kinds of practices underpin different green worlds – and how do they shape value chain governance? What are the main features of the green regime of accumulation that crystallizes around these worlds? How does this regime in turn support or disrupt dominant green worlds in particular locations and value chains, and in time—reinforcing, adjusting or breaking a green cycle of capital accumulation?

By comparing selected agro-food value chains (avocados, biodiesel, coffee and wine) in five countries (Argentina, Colombia, Indonesia, Italy and South Africa), the project seeks to explain the contradictory entanglement of ecological concern and capital accumulation, and the limits and possibilities of green transformations.

The PhD application should reflect an independently formulated research project that addresses some of these questions. For this position, we are looking for a candidate who would work empirically on two agro-food value chains (biodiesel and coffee), especially in Indonesia but also globally.

About the PhD programme

The three-year PhD programme at CBS gives you the opportunity to conduct research under the supervision of CBS’s associate professors and professors, supported by research-related PhD courses. The programme is highly international, and you are expected to participate in international research conferences and to spend time at another research institution as a visiting PhD student. See the CBS homepage for more information about the PhD programme: www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-cbs. 

CBS PhD graduates are held in high esteem not only in academia and research institutions but also in government and business where their research qualifications are in high demand.

CBS is committed to ensuring excellence, transformative and relevant teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us must be interested in working in an organisation of this type and it is expected that the applicant shows an interest in joining the department's research environments. You can read more about the department's research here: https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/department-management-society-and-communication.

Application and admission requirements

The department will give priority to applicants with high grades from their universities.

To be considered the applicant must:

• have an education at master's level (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process)
• have received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master's thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale (https://ufsn.dk/english/education/recognition-and-transparency/)
• have a weighted grade point average of at least 8.2 on the Danish 7-point grading scale for the bachelor's and master's degree combined or alternatively a weighted grade point average must be at least 9.5 for the master's degree alone. If the grade point average is not met, documentation for being in the top 40% of the class is also accepted. In rare cases, the grade requirement can be waived
• have a relevant educational background in the social sciences
• have completed the master's programme before the application deadline
• be in command of academic English at a high level in writing and speaking
• ability to conduct fieldwork in Bahasa Indonesia is desirable
The application must include an independently written and original (this means no generative AI usage) PhD project description (max 5 pages / 2,000 words excluding references) related to the research objectives of GreenWorlds. The project description must include:

• a presentation of a research question
• a description of the initial theoretical framework and methods
• a presentation of the proposed empirical focus
• a work plan for the three years
In addition to the project description, copies of the following must be included:

• diploma for bachelor's and master's degree or other certificates at an equivalent level as well as the grade transcripts
• documentation for being in the top 40% of the class (if grade requirements are not met)
• a concise academic curriculum vitae (CV)
• if relevant, a list of articles and publications
• one example of a selected written work (e.g. master's thesis)
• documentation of English language skills is not required for the application but may be requested if the applicant is shortlisted for interviews.
The PhD student is enrolled in the CBS PhD School. Further information about the PhD programme can be found at www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-cbs.

Employment and salary

A PhD scholarship runs for a period of three years and includes teaching obligations corresponding to 416 work hours. The scholarships are fully salaried positions, according to the national Danish collective agreement. The scholarship includes tuition fees, office space, course and travel costs (according to the current CBS agreement). 

Salary level and employment take place in accordance with the Ministry of Finance's agreement with the Academics' Central Organization.

Recruitment procedure 

The Recruitment Committee shortlists at least two applicants to be assessed by the Assessment Committee. Applicants are informed whether their application has proceeded for assessment.

Applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and will receive their personal assessment later.

Selected applicants will be invited for an interview. Please note that a positive assessment does not automatically result in an interview. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application. 

We expect to conduct interviews in late January/February 2027.

For further information please contact:

• Academic Contact: Professor Stefano Ponte, spo.msc@cbs.dk 
• HR and hiring process contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk
The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link.
Application due: Friday, 6 November 2026. No applications will be accepted beyond the deadline.
Expected starting date: March/April 2027 or soon thereafter

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

• 
A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

• 
Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

• 
An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

• 
Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

• 
Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

• 
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

• 
A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computational Proteomics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark
Location: Odense, Denmark
Duration: 2 years, with the possibility of a 1-year extension
Starting Date: 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter

Project Description
We invite applications for a postdoctoral position at the interface of computational proteomics, machine learning, and mass spectrometry. The successful candidate will join a pioneering research program focused on peptide ionization and fragmentation in LC-MS/MS, with the aim of developing new computational approaches for peptide fragmentation analysis.

The project centers on large-scale, experimentally curated tandem mass spectrometry datasets and the development of new computational strategies for fragmentation analysis under analytically underexplored conditions. It relies on modern machine learning approaches to model fragmentation behavior, support spectral interpretation, and enable future advances in peptide identification workflows.

The position is embedded in the Protein Research Group (PRG) at the University of Southern Denmark, an internationally recognized environment in proteomics and biological mass spectrometry. The postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with experimental colleagues generating high-quality tandem MS data for computational development.

Research Environment and Collaborative Structure
The Protein Research Group comprises eight PI-led teams and more than 50 researchers and students, offering a highly interactive and interdisciplinary research environment. The successful candidate will play a central role in the computational arm of the project and will collaborate closely with experimental researchers developing new mass spectrometric methods and generating large-scale fragmentation datasets.

The position offers substantial scientific independence and the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of machine learning, peptide chemistry, and proteomics.

Responsibilities
The postdoctoral researcher will be expected to:

• 
Develop computational and machine learning workflows for large-scale analysis of tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
Contribute to the structuring, curation, and quality control of large experimental MS/MS datasets 

• 
Build data-driven models for peptide fragmentation analysis using experimentally generated spectra 

• 
Integrate relevant variables such as peptide sequence, precursor charge state, collision energy, and peptide modifications into computational frameworks 

• 
Evaluate model performance using suitable similarity, quality, and generalization metrics 

• 
Contribute to the extension of computational models toward chemically and biologically relevant peptide classes, including selected post-translational modifications 

• 
Investigate how computational models may help reveal fragmentation trends and chemically meaningful patterns in large-scale MS/MS datasets 

• 
Work independently on model development, implementation, and computational problem solving, while interacting closely with experimental researchers in the group 

• 
Contribute to reproducible and well-documented computational pipelines, data structures, and analysis workflows 

• 
Disseminate findings through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and open scientific resources where relevant 

Required Qualifications
Applicants must have:

• 
A PhD in computational proteomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, computer science, chemometrics, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field 

• 
Strong experience in machine learning and/or deep learning applied to complex scientific datasets 

• 
Demonstrated ability to independently develop computational solutions, including model design, implementation, evaluation, and documentation 

• 
Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning/data science frameworks 

• 
Experience with data preprocessing, curation, and quality control for large and complex datasets 

• 
A strong analytical mindset and the ability to work independently on computational research problems 

• 
Interest in working at the interface of computation, chemistry, and mass spectrometry 

Desirable Qualifications
The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

• 
Experience with mass spectrometry-based proteomics, computational mass spectrometry, or peptide fragmentation-related data analysis 

• 
Experience with neural network architectures relevant for sequence-based prediction tasks 

• 
Experience with model interpretability, explainable AI, or feature analysis in scientific machine learning 

• 
Interest in peptide chemistry, gas-phase ion behavior, or post-translational modifications 

• 
Experience with reproducible workflows, FAIR data principles, and scalable computational pipelines 

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively across computational and experimental disciplines 

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of proteomics, mass spectrometry, and machine learning on scientifically ambitious and methodologically innovative research 

• 
The opportunity to develop computational methods for experimentally generated high-quality tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
A central and independent role in shaping the computational direction of a new research effort 

• 
Close collaboration with experimental researchers working on peptide ionization, fragmentation, and advanced LC-MS/MS method development 

• 
A strong interdisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning proteomics, biological mass spectrometry, peptide chemistry, and data analysis 

• 
Access to state-of-the-art mass spectrometry platforms and large in-house datasets 

• 
An international and collaborative research culture with opportunities for scientific development, publication, and conference participation 

• 
Competitive salary and benefits according to Danish collective agreements, including pension and support for international candidates where relevant 

About the Protein Research Group
The Protein Research Group at SDU is internationally recognized for pioneering work in biological mass spectrometry, peptide and protein chemistry, gas-phase chemistry, and proteomics. Research in the group spans fundamental analytical chemistry, method development, structural biology, post-translational modifications, and translational applications in biomedicine and biotechnology.

Located in Odense, the group offers an open, collaborative, and ambitious research environment with a strong emphasis on scientific rigor, interdisciplinary exchange, and long-term platform building. The successful candidate will join a setting in which computational and experimental researchers work in close interaction.

Application deadline: 16. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time. 

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Two Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains – GreenWorlds ERC Advanced project
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School (CBS) invites applications for two 3-year Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains, located at the Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC).

The selected candidates will contribute to the ERC Advanced research project Green Worlds: The material and normative drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains (GreenWorlds), led by Professor Stefano Ponte.

Overall Project Focus

The GreenWorlds project investigates a core tension in the global economy: how capitalism adapts to ecological pressures and normatively legitimizes itself while maintaining its core logic of capital accumulation alongside the carbon economy. To explore this, the project examines how a variety of ‘green worlds’ of value and valuation emerge, consolidate and decline. Green worlds are different sets of internally coherent principles that are drawn upon by value chain actors to deal with challenges and critiques. They are flexibly assembled by a variety of actors in different value chains and situations to enact justifications related to framing products and/or operations as ‘green’.

The research project asks: What counts as green and for whom? What kinds of practices underpin different green worlds – and how do they shape value chain governance? What are the main features of the green regime of accumulation that crystallizes around these worlds? How does this regime in turn support or disrupt dominant green worlds in particular locations and value chains, and in time—reinforcing, adjusting or breaking a green cycle of capital accumulation?

By comparing selected agro-food value chains (avocados, biodiesel, coffee and wine) in five countries (Argentina, Colombia, Indonesia, Italy and South Africa), the project seeks to explain the contradictory entanglement of ecological concern and capital accumulation, and the limits and possibilities of green transformations.

As part of GreenWorlds, the Post Doctoral candidates will contribute to activities such as:

• Conducting literature reviews and theoretical analysis for publication in top-tier academic outlets.
• Conducting and participating in field research (especially by carrying out key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and participant observation).
• Collaborating in coding of qualitative data (including the basics of natural language processing)
• Presenting, writing and publishing academic papers in peer-reviewed international journals, also in collaboration with the other members of the team
• Engaging in public outreach activities (e.g., blog posts, Linkedin entries, short videos, podcasts).
• Post Doc 1 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and biodiesel), especially in Argentina but also globally.
• Post Doc 2 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and avocados), especially in South Africa but also globally.
Qualifications

The applicant has obtained a PhD or equivalent by the start date of the Post Doctoral position. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on research potential – both theoretical and empirical.

The Post-Doctoral positions are non-tenured positions for a 3-year period with research obligations.

To meet the research obligations, the selected candidate is expected to be on site and take part in departmental activities.

Emphasis is placed on research relevant to the job description.

Applicants should have:

• A PhD in the social sciences (e.g., political science, sociology, economic geography)
• Experience with qualitative fieldwork
• Knowledge of the academic literature on international political economy, and/or environmental politics, and/or pragmatic sociology/convention theory, and/or global value chain analysis
• High-level English Language proficiency
• Willingness to reside in Denmark and engage regularly with the CBS research community
• For Post Doc 1, ability to conduct fieldwork in Spanish is required

The Department

The Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC) brings together scholars from a range of research areas within management, communication and the broader social sciences and humanities, studying organizations in global environments and the interaction and interdependencies of business, society and government. They share a common interest in studying organizations in global environments and the relations of organizations to the wider society. Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/msc.

MSC is a significant supplier of research-based teaching to a broad portfolio of programs, which includes undergraduate, graduate and doctoral teaching and supervision as well as executive education in the fields of:

• Responsible management, leadership and governance
• Corporate responsibility and sustainability
• Business and development (with an emphasis on the emerging/growth economies context)
• Organisational communication (corporate communication, strategic communication, leadership communication, marketing communication, international business communication)
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type. 

For further information please contact:

• Academic Contact: Professor Stefano Ponte spo.msc@cbs.dk 
• HR and hiring process contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk 
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link.

The application must include:

• Cover letter (summary of research skills) discussing your alignment with the research objectives of GreenWorlds
• An independently written and original (this means no generative AI usage) 3-year project proposal related to the research objectives of GreenWorlds (max 5 pages / 2,000 words excluding references).
• Complete publication list (mark up to 5 for assessment with *)
• Copies of selected publications (English only)
• Documentation of fieldwork and, if relevant, research management experience

It must be clearly indicated in the cover letter as well as the project proposal if the application concerns Post Doc project 1 or Post Doc project 2. If an applicant wishes to apply for both positions, a separate project description must be submitted for each.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application materials by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk.

Application due: Friday, 6 November 2026. No applications will be accepted beyond the deadline.
Expected starting date: March 2027 or soon thereafter.

This position is open for candidates located in Warsaw (PL) area or Odense (DK) area.

Are you passionate about quality, GMP compliance, and supporting successful product launches and technology transfers?

At Orifarm, we are looking for a dedicated Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Innovation & Launch team. You will provide QA support across product launches and technology transfers, ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) to secure compliant and efficient implementation of new products and processes.

About the job

As QA Specialist, you will support product launches and technology transfers from a QA perspective. You will provide quality oversight, collaborate across functions and help ensure compliant and timely product supply while balancing quality requirements with business priorities.

Key responsibilities:

• Providing QA support and oversight for product launches and technology transfers.

• Collaborating with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant implementation.

• Ensuring documentation and activities comply with approved procedures, specifications, GMP requirements, and regulatory expectations.

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation, including Master Batch Records and Batch Journals, as part of the broader QA responsibility portfolio.

• Identifying, resolving, and escalating quality and compliance issues when required.

• Participating in change controls, deviations, and risk assessments.

• Driving continuous improvement of QA processes and ways of working.

Who are you?

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where quality, compliance, and business needs must be balanced. You are structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks.

We expect that you:

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

• Have experience from QA/QC, manufacturing, process support, or another GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with manufacturing documentation is an advantage.

• Have solid knowledge of EU GMP requirements.

• Can work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures.

Who are we?

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative QA organization where professionalism, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

In Innovation & Launch, we support product launches and technology transfers across Orifarm’s international supply network. We work closely with manufacturing sites, CMOs, project teams, and commercial stakeholders to ensure products reach the market with the right quality and at the right time.

What we offer?

• A key quality role with significant responsibility and impact.

• International collaboration across manufacturing sites and partners.

• A high degree of independence and flexibility.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

• Hybrid working model and flexible working hours.

• Attractive compensation and benefits package – details depend on job location.

Job location

Odense (DK) or Warsaw (PL).

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Department: Clinical

Location: EMEA-Denmark

**Description

**Our mission is to develop and execute high-quality clinical education programs while supporting strategic clinical relations to drive clinical confidence, adoption, and growth across the market.

As a Clinical Relations and Education Specialist, you are responsible for independent program execution with relationship development. You will work closely with your manager to support universities, faculty, and key opinion leaders (KOLs), while contributing to regional education strategy and cross-functional initiatives. You will drive adoption and growth, build clinical confidence of customers through education on Align’s Clinical Protocols, Digital Innovations across the iTero Platform and the ClinCheck® Software.

The role sits at the intersection of education delivery, program management, and clinical relations development, with increasing ownership and influence across the Nordics region.

**Role expectations
